$schema_comment: KnoSky DEC-108 tool menu SSOT — Wave 1 freeze. README = wiki = site = binary must match.

coding.description: Default agent packs (Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, VS Code MCP). No audit ledger tools.

security.description: Operator / security / CI verify profile. Includes coding tools plus audit tools.

advisory.description: Explicit non-authorizing exploration. Mode A labels required. Must not be marketed as governed.

tools.name: kc_search
tools.summary: Search map nodes by text/metadata over the city index.

tools.name: kc_get_node
tools.summary: Fetch a single node projection by id.

tools.name: kc_get_provenance
tools.summary: Return provenance pointers for a node (live SoT refs).

tools.name: kc_route
tools.summary: Route GPS toward a destination. Dual-mode: Mode B ALLOW/DENY_* with receipt, or labeled Mode A ADVISORY_UNAUTH.

tools.name: kc_bundle
tools.summary: Build share-oriented intent-manifest/bundle under same gates + fail-closed secret scan.

tools.name: kc_policy_check
tools.summary: Dry-run policy decision + reasons without full route body.

tools.name: kc_audit_query
tools.summary: Query local route/swarm decision audit events (metadata-only).
